subject: Maintain return value of rdbSaveDb after writing slot-info aux (#1222)
reason: The change only adds `written += res;` so rdbSaveDb's returned byte count includes the slot-info aux field. rdbSaveDb has a single caller (rdbSaveRio, src/rdb.c:1423) which only checks the return value for -1 (error); the non-negative byte count is never read by any code path. The bytes written to the RDB stream are identical on both builds — the fix corrects an internal counter nobody consumes, so there is no observable behaviour change (no reply, no RDB content, no replication or persistence effect) for a scenario to exercise or an oracle to judge.
